These commands are available three ways — in the FREE-WILi GUI app, in a serial
terminal, and on the device itself. See
[Connecting it to a computer](../start-here/connecting.md) for how to reach them.

> **Note:** These settings live on the display CPU but are stored and saved by the main processor - the same sound categories the on-screen Settings (Display) panel shows.

## Quiet Threshold

The mic level that counts as an active sound

**How to use it** — press `f`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## Speaker Volume

The multiplier applied to sound playback

**How to use it** — press `v`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## Recording Volume

The multiplier applied to mic recording

**How to use it** — press `c`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## Record Len Sec

The default length of a recording in seconds

**How to use it** — press `r`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## System Sounds

Sounds for system events (also gates all audio playback)

**How to use it** — press `p`.
